notes: Eleven facts: six from the M-PESA customer terms and the tariffs page (reversal windows, finality, self-reversal to 456), five from CBK consumer-protection rules (acknowledgement, oral escalation, e-money complaint windows, regulator escalation).

sources.name: Safaricom PLC, M-PESA Charges (consumer tariffs and limits page, published 16 Aug 2022, last updated 4 Aug 2026)
Safaricom PLC, M-PESA Customer Terms and Conditions
Central Bank of Kenya, E-Money Regulation 2013 (National Payment System Act)
Central Bank of Kenya Prudential Guidelines 2013, Guideline on Consumer Protection (effective 1 Jan 2013)

entries.subject: mpesa_transaction_finality
entries.value_text: A completed M-PESA transaction is final and irrevocable; Safaricom is under no compulsion to reverse it
entries.display: Reversal is discretionary, not a right
entries.quote: 8 13 a transaction once completed is final and irrevocable as such safaricom shall not be under any compulsion to reverse any transaction
entries.notes: Clause 8.13; clause 8.14 creates the narrow exception. Ligature in the PDF ('ﬁ') was flattened to 'fi' in the quote.

entries.subject: mpesa_reversal_claim_window
entries.display: A reversal claim for manifest error or fraud must be made within one month of the transaction
entries.quote: safaricom reserves the right at its sole discretion to cancel or reverse a transaction if reasonable grounds such as manifest error or fraud are shown and provided that the recipient has not redeemed the e money and the reversal claim is made within one 1 month of the erroneous transaction date
entries.notes: Two conditions: recipient has not redeemed, and claim inside one month. Discretionary, not guaranteed.

entries.subject: no_refund_after_redemption
entries.value_text: No refund or compensation if the money was sent in error or by fraud and has already been redeemed
entries.display: Once the wrong recipient cashes out, the sender bears the loss
entries.quote: safaricom will not be compelled to refund or compensate the sender if the e money is sent to a recipient mistakenly or in error or fraudulently or under duress and subsequently redeemed for cash

entries.subject: recipient_duty_to_return_funds
entries.value_text: A recipient of funds sent in error must return them, failing which Safaricom may reverse the payment, and may face prosecution
entries.display: Keeping money sent to you by mistake is a criminal risk
entries.quote: if you receive funds in error you acknowledge that you shall be obliged to return the funds to the sender failing which safaricom may reverse the payment to the sender
entries.notes: Clause 9.3 adds that consuming such funds can attract criminal prosecution.

entries.subject: unregistered_recipient_voucher_expiry
entries.display: A voucher sent to a non-registered recipient is cancelled after 7 days and the money returned
entries.quote: if within 7 days or such shorter or longer period as may be determined by safaricom of the transaction being made to a non registered recipient the recipient has not opened or cashed their voucher safaricom will cancel the transaction
entries.notes: Safaricom may set a shorter or longer period; 7 days is the stated default.

entries.subject: self_reversal_channel
entries.value_text: Forward the transaction confirmation SMS to 456 to initiate a self reversal
entries.display: Self-service reversal is triggered by forwarding the SMS to 456
entries.quote: to initiate an m pesa self reversal forward your transaction confirmation message to 456

entries.subject: complaint_acknowledgement_deadline
entries.display: A bank must acknowledge a written complaint within 7 days
entries.quote: an institution on receiving a complaint shall provide the co mplainant with a prompt written acknowledgement at least within 7 days of receipt that it has received the complaint and is dealing with it
entries.notes: CBK Prudential Guideline on Consumer Protection, effective 1 January 2013.

entries.subject: oral_complaint_escalation
entries.display: An oral complaint unresolved after 48 hours must be confirmed to the customer in writing
entries.quote: where a complaint which was submitted orally is not resolve d within forty eight hours the institution shall confirm to the consumer in writing through electronic means

entries.subject: emoney_complaint_lodgement_window
entries.display: An e-money complaint must be lodged within 30 days of the incident
entries.quote: complaints may be lodged orally or in writing but in each case must be lodged within a period of 30 days from the date of occurrence
entries.notes: Complaints also carry a right to escalate internally if the customer is unsatisfied (clause 12.10). effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: emoney_complaint_resolution_deadline
entries.display: All e-money complaints must be resolved within 60 days of lodgement
entries.quote: all complaints shall be resolved within sixty days of being lodged
entries.notes: The regulation states the same 60-day ceiling twice (clauses 12.3 and 12.7). effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: escalation_to_regulator
entries.value_text: A customer may refer an unresolved dispute to the Central Bank of Kenya
entries.display: Unresolved M-PESA disputes can go to CBK
entries.quote: you are also at liberty to refer any dispute that is not resolved to your satisfaction to the central bank of kenya
entries.notes: Path: customer care (234) -> M-PESA operations manager -> CBK -> Kenyan court (clauses 16.1-16.4).
